description: This header defines the DnsConfigServiceWin class for Windows DNS configuration management, including functions for parsing domain names and search lists, and for reading and watching DNS settings on Windows systems.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin
classes.description: Service class for reading and watching Windows DNS configuration settings, not thread-safe, performs blocking I/O, used for DNS configuration management.

methods.name: ReadHostsNow
methods.description: Reads the hosts file DNS entries.

methods.name: StartWatching
methods.description: Starts watching for DNS configuration changes.
